item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 14/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong today. A strong replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of southern China later on Monday. It will be windy over the region midweek this week. A cold front is expected to move across southern China over the weekend. The weather will become appreciably cooler over the region in the following few days.
